calibrationNotes: Older G/PG catalog titles often have low global ages but meaningful violence/scariness notes.
Some low-age classics require prose callouts for death, grief, or abandonment even without a Sad slider.
Drinking varies sharply across musicals and classics, so it should not be inferred from age alone.
